note: Phase 14, THE contract of this family: `intern-soft` answers nil on a miss and does NOT intern as a side effect. Two consecutive probes of a fresh name both answer nil; an implementation that interns on a miss answers the symbol the second time, and a program written around `(while (setq x (intern-soft (format ...))) ...)` -- a real idiom in Gnus' message.el -- then allocates until it runs out of arena.
